properties.notes: Identified in the Rugeley TC Area Action Plan as a site for re-development as part of re-organisation of secondary school provision in Rugeley. County Council previously undertaken pre-application work for an extra care and residential scheme for circa 85 dwellings but this is no longer to be progressed. County Council pursuing disposal, which may result in lower density scheme. Willing to sell. Net developable area circa 1.6ha.
